sources.title: davidnichols-ops/qwen3-0.6b-devin-draft · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Draft model for speculative decoding, distilled from the fine-tuned Qwen3-4B Devin SFT target model. The 0.6B model proposes tokens; the 4B target model verifies them, giving 2-3x inference speedup.
